draft: The Security Council supports continued reporting under the United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change on implementation of the Glasgow Climate Pact, including commitments on climate finance and technology transfer, and requests the Secretary-General to assess, in existing reports to the Council on regions and issues on its agenda, how climate change affects risks to international peace and security in each context where it is relevant.

history.text: The Security Council requests the Secretary-General to draw on expertise across the United Nations system and report annually to the Council on how climate change affects risks to international peace and security.

The Security Council supports reporting through the established processes of the United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change, with all developing countries participating, on progress in implementing the Glasgow Climate Pact, including the fulfilment of commitments on climate finance and technology transfer, without requesting a separate report to the Council on climate-related security risks.

The Security Council supports continued reporting under the United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change on implementation of the Glasgow Climate Pact, including commitments on climate finance and technology transfer, and requests the Secretary-General to assess, in existing reports to the Council on regions and issues on its agenda, how climate change affects risks to international peace and security in each context where it is relevant.

We accept this wording. Assessing climate-related security risks in existing reports gives the Council a way to consider how those risks vary across the regions and issues on its agenda, alongside continued reporting under the Convention on finance and technology commitments.

GBR.reason: Existing reports would help the Council assess how climate change affects security risks in each relevant context, while reporting under the Convention continues to track commitments on finance and technology transfer.

IND.reason: We support reporting on the Glasgow Climate Pact through the Convention, but even in existing reports the draft asks the Council to assess climate change through a separate security lens.

FRA.reason: Assessments in existing reports would help the Council address climate-related security risks where they arise, region by region and issue by issue.
